newsitem.title: USA: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit won't restart Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit won't restart Thursday.

text.p: The 1,073 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant in central California will not restart on Thursday, as earlier expected, a spokesman for Pacific Gas & Electric Co, the plant's owner, said Thursday.
The unit was taken off line at around 0500 PDT on Wednesday because of a problem with its feedwater system, but the company has not been able to determine the exact cause of the trip, he noted.
"All tests indicate that there is no problem, so we are still looking into it," the spokesman said.
He added the company aims to have the unit back up before the end of the Independence Day holiday weekend, when regional temperatures are expected to rise and power demand increase.
Diablo Canyon's neighboring 1,087 MW unit 1 was said to be operating normally.
